en.ammaar-muslim: 9. [9/306] al-Kafi: Ali b. Ibrahim from Muhammad b. Isa from Yunus from Abdallah b. Muskan from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام
about the words of Allah Mighty and Majestic: “(Ibrahim was) a Hanif, a Muslim” [3:67]. He said: sincere and devoted, not having in it (his faith) anything whatsoever of the worship of idols.
